verdict.rationale: Veriff's API is versioned: endpoints sit under a /v1 path prefix (e.g. POST /v1/sessions, GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision), the docs are organized under a v1 section, and a major-version SDK migration guide exists (Android 6.x.x to 9.0.0). However, the pack has no documented API deprecation policy, sunset timelines or changelog commitments, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, an API changelog or version lifecycle docs, and evidence of how multiple API versions are supported.
